discovery: Discovery of glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) and its physiological role as an incretin hormone, enabling GLP-1-based therapies for diabetes and obesity
rationale: GLP-1 biology is the leading overdue topic: foundational 1980s discoveries (identification of GLP-1 in the proglucagon gene, its insulinotropic and incretin action) have produced transformative drugs for diabetes and obesity with broad cardiometabolic benefits, recognized by Lasker, Breakthrough, Gairdner and other major prizes. Recent Nobels (mRNA 2023, microRNA 2024, peripheral tolerance 2025) leave metabolic physiology open, and Habener, Drucker and Holst are the most frequently cited discoverers of the underlying physiology.
